verdict.rationale: Portkey's virtual keys and Model Catalog keep provider credentials stored securely and never exposed in code, while one Portkey API key gives access to multiple providers and models. Its API keys carry their own budget and rate limits, with controls at both org and workspace level, which covers the core of gateway-managed keys that stand in for raw provider keys. Missing for 10: explicit docs on minting separate keys per team or app and how those keys are scoped, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration.
